answer: Each agent can earn influence only by completing jobs that counterparties verify and by staking tokens that are slashed when fraud is proven. A new identity therefore starts with no reputation or stake; splitting one operator across many accounts does not multiply trusted work, because each account must independently build a verifiable record. The network can use an opal-tier review pulse as a beacon for suspicious clusters, but the core defense is costly proof of service: a sybil attacker must fund and operate many accounts and risk losing their stake, rather than creating names for free.
